color.name: Jaundice
color.description: Yellowish pigmentation of the skin and sclerae
color.visual_prompt: distinct yellowish scleral icterus in the whites of both eyes with a subtle yellow undertone across the facial skin

color.name: Pallor
color.description: Unusual lightness of skin color or pale mucous membranes/lips
color.visual_prompt: noticeably pale, washed-out lips and pallid, bloodless facial complexion

color.name: Cyanosis
color.description: Bluish or purplish discoloration due to low oxygen saturation
color.visual_prompt: distinct bluish-purple central cyanotic discoloration of the lips and perioral region

color.name: Facial Flushing / Erythema
color.description: Reddening of the face due to fever, vasodilation or heat
color.visual_prompt: visible febrile facial flushing and warm redness across both cheeks and forehead

structural_symmetric.name: Periorbital Edema
structural_symmetric.description: Swelling or puffiness around both eyes
structural_symmetric.visual_prompt: symmetrical swelling and puffiness around both upper and lower eyelids (periorbital edema)

structural_symmetric.name: Diaphoresis / Sweating
structural_symmetric.description: Visible beads of perspiration and sheen on the skin
structural_symmetric.visual_prompt: visible glistening sheen and fine beads of sweat across the forehead and temples

structural_symmetric.name: Glassy Eyes
structural_symmetric.description: Unfocused, moist or glazed ocular appearance typical of fever
structural_symmetric.visual_prompt: moist, slightly glazed and fatigued appearance of both eyes

structural_asymmetric.name: Ptosis (Drooping Eyelid)
structural_asymmetric.description: Abnormal low-lying upper eyelid on one or both sides (Horner, palsy, myasthenia)
structural_asymmetric.visual_prompt: abnormal drooping of the upper eyelid partially covering the upper iris and pupil
structural_asymmetric.unilateral_prompt: asymmetric drooping of only the patient's {side} upper eyelid partially covering the pupil, while the patient's {opposite} eye remains normally open

structural_asymmetric.name: Facial Droop / Asymmetry
structural_asymmetric.description: Weakness and downward sagging of mouth angle or nasolabial fold (stroke, Bell's palsy)
structural_asymmetric.visual_prompt: downward sagging of the mouth corner and flattened nasolabial fold
structural_asymmetric.unilateral_prompt: unilateral downward sagging of only the patient's {side} mouth corner with a flattened {side} nasolabial fold, while the patient's {opposite} side of the face retains normal tone

secretions.name: Rhinorrhea / Runny Nose
secretions.description: Excessive clear or mucoid nasal discharge
secretions.visual_prompt: clear glistening nasal discharge beneath the nostrils with mild redness around the nasal rim

secretions.name: Epiphora / Weepy Eyes
secretions.description: Overflow of tears onto the face
secretions.visual_prompt: excessive watery tearing overflowing at the lower eyelid margins
secretions.unilateral_prompt: watery tearing overflowing from only the patient's {side} eye onto the {side} cheek, while the {opposite} eye remains dry
